_source.purpose: Free, citable construction cost figures for pricing courses of action (ADU, small multifamily, station-area building, conventional vs prefabricated). Data only; not wired into the engine or page.

icc.table: ICC Building Valuation Data, February 2026: 27 occupancy groups x 9 construction types; 'N.P.' (not permitted) cells omitted
icc.copies_agree: all 243 table cells identical (checked by this script)
icc.header_discrepancy: The Albuquerque copy heads the table 'Group (2024 International Building Code)'; the Hermiston copy 'Group (2021 International Building Code)'. The numbers are identical.
footnotes_in_copy: b. For shell only buildings deduct 20 percent
a. Private Garages use Utility, miscellaneous
d. Unfinished basements (Group R-3) = $31.50 per sq. ft.
icc.edition_statement: Source: International Code Council, Building Valuation Data, February 2026
icc.latest_edition_note: ICC updates the table every six months; an August 2026 edition may exist but no copy of it could be found (Irvine's 'effective August 15, 2026' page carries a REV 06/24 table). February 2026 is the latest obtained.
icc_statements: The average costs include foundation work, structural and nonstructural building components, electrical, plumbing, mechanical and interior finish material.
The data is a national average and does not take into account any regional cost differences.
This data table is not intended to be used as an estimating guide because the data only reflects average costs and is not representative of specific construction.
The BVD will be updated at six-month intervals
icc.icc_statements_caveat: These statements are from ICC's August 2020 edition article; ICC's pages for the 2026 edition are members-only and could not be read.
